Read the existing constraint: kubectl get blockprivilegedcontainer block-privileged-containers -o yaml — look at spec.match.kinds and notice which resource types are listed.

The constraint only matches apiGroups:["apps"] kinds:["Deployment"]. Bare Pods use apiGroups:[""] (empty string = core group). Try: kubectl run priv-test -n dojo-sec-opa --image=busybox --overrides='{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"c","image":"busybox","securityContext":{"privileged":true},"command":["sleep","1"]}]}}' — it should succeed (the gap).
Fix: kubectl edit blockprivilegedcontainer block-privileged-containers — add {"apiGroups":[""], "kinds":["Pod"]} to spec.match.kinds then run bash verify.sh
